title: Vision Plans Rate Sheet: Plan Line-Up, Markets and Monthly Premiums
content:
Cascade Mutual Dental & Vision sells six Vision Plans. This rate sheet sets out the markets each plan is sold in, the smallest employer group that can take it, and the individual monthly premium by coverage tier (USD per month).

| Plan | Rank | Markets | Smallest group (enrolled lives) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 1 | individual, group | 2 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 2 | individual, group | 2 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 3 | individual, group | 2 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 4 | individual, group | 2 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 5 | individual, group | 5 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 6 | group | 10 |

**Individual monthly premium by coverage tier**

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member only | 6.48 | 9.86 | 12.34 | 14.72 | 17.95 | 22.40 |
| Member and spouse | 12.31 | 18.73 | 23.45 | 27.97 | 34.10 | 42.56 |
| Member and children | 12.96 | 19.72 | 24.68 | 29.44 | 35.90 | 44.80 |
| Family | 19.05 | 28.99 | 36.28 | 43.28 | 52.77 | 65.86 |

**Rate sheet notes**

- Each coverage tier has its own individual monthly rate: member only, member and spouse, member and children, and family.
- Computed amounts on the Vision Plans are rounded half up to the cent.
- Cascade Vision Premier 200 is sold to employer groups only. Every other plan is sold to individuals and to groups, Choice 175 to groups of at least 5 enrolled lives and the others to groups of at least 2.
